description:
Chapter 2 of SCP: Fragmented Minds is out now on Steam Early Access. Watch the SCP: Fragmented Minds Chapter 2 launch trailer for this new chapter of the psychological horror game, which brings new horrors, evolving environments, and new systems overhaul. 

This new chapter pushes players further into the fractured remains of Site-113, introducing 15 new areas to explore, including the shifting North Wing—a dynamic location that evolves as players progress—and The Forest, a mysterious and unsettling zone built around a major puzzle encounter tied to a highly requested SCP. Every step forward reveals new threats, new systems, and new questions about what truly happened.

author: GameTrailers
description:
Mini Worlds Dioramas is out now on PC via Steam. Watch the Mini Worlds Dioramas launch trailer for this creativity-first sandbox where making something small and personal is the entire experience.

Mini Worlds Dioramas is built around the experience of creating tiny worlds, one detail at a time. Players can settle in and shape their dioramas at their own pace, placing scenery, characters, and small touches that gradually bring each space to life. With controls that make building feel effortless, the experience encourages experimentation, iteration, and the simple satisfaction of watching a tiny world come together.

Players can explore a range of themed environments, including Sci-Fi, City, Mediterranean, and Western, each offering its own look and feel. These themes give players a starting point, but there’s plenty of freedom to experiment, mix ideas, and build something entirely their own.
title: Mini Worlds Dioramas - Official Launch Trailer

description:
Watch the latest Willow Guard trailer to see what to expect with the Frostreign DLC, which brings a companion, new mysteries to solve, the ability to build your character, crafting, upgrades, and loot to the story-driven dark fantasy RPG. The Frostreign DLC for Willow Guard will be available on PC on April 23, 2026.

In Willow Guard, play as Ghweros, a Willowguard investigating a series of monster attacks on a remote village close to the northern Hinterlands. Discover a hand-crafted, original fantasy world full of uplifted animals, absent gods, and thousand years of buried secrets to unfold. In the Frostreign DLC, the tale of our brave badger continues as the party sets out for Regnum Polis, racing to prevent another monstrous breakthrough before the next Solstice. The journey from Woikos leads through the frozen Atalaka Mountains, now rendered impassable by an unnatural winter brought on by Louksna. The only safe passage lies in the use of ancient portals.

author: GameTrailers
description:
Morbid Metal is a hack-and-slash action roguelite where you play as the last AI, created by the mysterious Operator and trapped in a post-apocalyptic simulation. Switch seamlessly between three powerful characters – Flux, Ekku, and Vekta – at any point, whether you’re exploring vibrant ruined landscapes or mid-combat. Each character has a distinct fighting style and signature skills that you can chain together through shapeshifting for stylish and powerful combos. The more creative you are with your attack combos, the better style score you’ll get at the end of your run. 

This trailer spotlights Flux, who the developers describe as follows: "Flux is a lightning-fast, precision-focused killer designed to dominate single-target combat. Armed with razor-sharp skills and blink-speed mobility, Flux excels at surgical strikes, dodge counters, and execution-heavy play that rewards timing and mastery." 

Play over 10 hours of content in the Early Access release of Morbid Metal when it launch
title: Morbid Metal: Official 'Flux' Character Spotlight Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Bases Loaded 2: Second Season and Goal! Two are out now on Nintendo Switch and PlayStation 5 (PS5). Watch the Bases Loaded 2: Second Season and Goal! Two launch trailer for these retro sports collections as part of the Jaleco Sports series. 

Bases Loaded II: Second Season, a baseball simulation collection, features five games total, including both Bases Loaded II: Second Season  (US -NES 1989) and Moero!! Pro Yakyuu '88 Kettei Ban (Japan-Famicom - 1988), as well as three Super Nintendo/Super Famicom titles: Super Bases Loaded II (US-SNES- 1994), Super 3D Baseball (Japan-Super Famicom -1992) and Hanguk Pro Yagu (Korea - Super Comboy - 1994).

Jaleco Sports: Goal! Two, a football/soccer collection,  includes four games - three from the Nintendo Entertainment System/Famicom era - Goal! Two (US-NES-1989), Goal! 2 (Europe-NES-1989),  Goal!  (Japan - Famicom -1989) - and one title from the Super Nintendo, Super Goal! 2 (US-SNES - 1992).

New features introduced in Rock It's sports releases
title: Jaleco Sports: Bases Loaded 2: Second Season and Goal! Two - Official Launch Trailer
